prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single tiny currency icon for the dark gothic fantasy game “Heroes of Orvesk”.
Create ONE original icon for the currency “Shards”: a shard of the consciousness of Logos, given to an ancient attractor stone in exchange for character growth. Show only the shard, not the attractor.
Subject: one thick, broad, irregular angular fragment of condensed luminous essence, an asymmetrical broken wedge with just THREE LARGE CLEAR FACETS. It should read immediately as a broken fragment, not a polished diamond, coin, flame or round soul. Pointed uneven top, broken blunt lower edge, compact sturdy silhouette, slight diagonal lean. The pale ivory inner core is almost opaque and bright, with subdued antique gold along one fracture and a muted sage gray shadow facet. A very thin darker edge defines the shape; a tiny restrained translucent halo closely hugs the contour. A hint of painterly mineral grain is sufficient; prioritize broad simple value masses.
Style: sculptural hand-painted gothic fantasy inventory illustration, restrained natural palette, directional light from upper left, tactile painterly surface; not cartoon, not flat vector, not shiny plastic or glossy neon 3D.
Composition: square 1024x1024 PNG canvas, centered single isolated object, entire silhouette visible. Shard occupies about 82% of canvas height and 65–70% of canvas width, with modest transparent margins. Deliberately designed to stay recognizable at 24x24 and 32x32 pixels: strong silhouette, three big facets, high contrast opaque core, no tiny decorative detail.
Background: TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA PNG, completely empty alpha outside the object and its narrow translucent contour halo. No background color, no painted checkerboard, no scene, no ground, no shadow plane, no border or frame.
No text, letters, numbers, faces, eyes, skulls, runes, starbursts, orbiting fragments, separate particles, additional crystals or long wispy trails. Output exactly one icon, not a sheet of variants or a mockup.
